agent.title: Background agent
agent.checkLogInDiagnostics: Check its log in Settings › Diagnostics

stoppedPanel.notStartedCheckLog: The agent did not start. Check its log for details.
stoppedPanel.explanation: The background agent handles devices and runs actions. It keeps running when this window is closed.
stoppedPanel.notFound: The agent executable was not found next to this application. Startdeckpilot-agentmanually.

supervision.restarting_one: It ended ({{exit}}). DeckPilot starts it again in {{count}} second (restart {{restart}} of {{max}}).
supervision.restarting_other: It ended ({{exit}}). DeckPilot starts it again in {{count}} seconds (restart {{restart}} of {{max}}).
supervision.gaveUp_one: It ended unexpectedly ({{exit}}) after being restarted {{count}} time in {{minutes}} minutes. It is not started again by itself.
supervision.gaveUp_other: It ended unexpectedly ({{exit}}) after being restarted {{count}} times in {{minutes}} minutes. It is not started again by itself.
supervision.notRestarted: It ended unexpectedly ({{exit}}) and could not be started again.

state.noHost: Not shown: no system tray found
state.hostUnknown: Created; not known whether it is shown

notice.title: The tray icon is not available
notice.noHost: DeckPilot found no system tray to show its icon in. On GNOME, the tray needs an AppIndicator extension; DeckPilot does not install one.
notice.unavailable: The tray icon could not be created, because the AppIndicator library is missing or could not be loaded.
notice.stillRunning: The background agent keeps running: your devices and actions work as usual. Without the tray there is no tray menu and no Quit DeckPilot there. Open DeckPilot from your applications menu, and stop the background agent here. Closing this window does not stop it.
notice.docs: More in the documentation: Troubleshooting › No tray icon.
notice.notStopped: The background agent was not stopped

stateHint.usbPresentHidUnavailable: The USB bus lists the Stream Deck, but its HID interface is missing, often behind a hub or monitor dock. Replug it, or power-cycle the hub.
stateHint.permissionDenied: The system does not allow DeckPilot to open the device. On Linux, check that the udev rule is installed, then replug the device.
stateHint.unsupported: DeckPilot has no driver for this model yet.
stateHint.busy: Another program has the device open. Quit it, then refresh devices.
stateHint.communicationError: The device opens but keeps failing. DeckPilot retries less often; check the cable or hub.
stateHint.reconnecting: The connection was lost. DeckPilot opens the device again shortly.
stateHint.unknown: Devices could not be listed. DeckPilot keeps trying.

feature.backgroundExecutions: background workflow runs and their history

title.updateRequired: The running agent is too old for this app
title.otherInstallation: The running agent belongs to another installation
title.mismatch: The running agent does not match this app

compatibility.otherInstallation: The agent was installed from {{agent}}, this app from {{app}}. DeckPilot works only with the agent of its own installation; restarting replaces it with this app's agent.
compatibility.replaceRequired: Nothing can be configured until it is replaced by the agent of this app.
compatibility.restartToMatch: Restart the agent so both run the same version.
compatibility.running_one: A workflow is running in the agent. Restarting now interrupts it; the history records that.
compatibility.running_other: {{count}} workflows are running in the agent. Restarting now interrupts them; the history records that.

refresh.label: Refresh devices
refresh.next: Check that the agent is running

models.supportedDescription: Models tested on a physical device on at least one platform. The badges show the status on each platform.
models.noneVerified: No model has been verified yet.
models.experimentalDescription: These models have not been tested on a physical device on any platform. Layouts can be designed for them, but they are not supported.

page.connectedDescription: Devices appear automatically when connected. Simulated devices are for development and testing. On Linux, a udev rule is required for access.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.detail: A work-in-progress definition that may be incomplete or wrong.

defined.label: Layout design only
defined.detail: Layouts can be designed and saved. There is no driver for this model.

driverImplemented.label: Driver, not tested
driverImplemented.detail: A driver exists for this platform, but it has not been tested.

automatedTests.label: Automated tests only
automatedTests.detail: The driver passes automated tests here, but has not been tested on a physical device.

physicallyVerified.label: Physically verified
physicallyVerified.detail: Tested on a physical device on this platform.

gestureDefaults.title: Gesture timing
gestureDefaults.description: Defaults for keys with a double click or long press. A key can use other values in the layout designer. Keys that only act on a press are not affected.
gestureDefaults.doubleClickHint: Time from releasing a key to pressing it again that still counts as a double click. A single click on a key with a double click waits this long.
gestureDefaults.longPressHint: How long a key must be held to count as a long press.

calls.title: Calls
calls.description: Shows the state of your calls on your devices and, where the call app allows it, controls them.
calls.detectionOnly: Microsoft Teams can only be detected: answering, ending, muting and the camera are not supported, because Microsoft retired its device API on 30 June 2026.
calls.noControls: This call app can only be detected: DeckPilot cannot answer, end, mute or turn the camera on or off for it.
calls.overlayDescription: During a call the device shows the Calls layout; your own layout stays as it was.
calls.suspended: Back to work: shows your own layout until the call comes back.
calls.overlayFailed: The setting could not be changed
calls.layoutDescription: Managed by the Calls plugin, for {{model}}.
calls.restoreKeeps: Your version is kept first as the layout “{{copy}}”, which no profile uses. Then the default layout is generated again.
calls.restoreUnedited: The layout is unchanged; it is generated again.
calls.restoredKept: The Calls layout was restored; your version is “{{copy}}”.
calls.restoreFailed: The Calls layout could not be restored
calls.pagesDescription: What the device shows during a call. A control the call app does not support stays on the page, disabled, with the reason.
calls.previewFailed: The page could not be shown on the device

reasons.teams: Not supported: Microsoft retired the Teams device API on 30 June 2026.
reasons.providerHasNoApi: Not supported: the call app offers no control.
reasons.toggleOnly: The call app can only switch it on and off.
reasons.needsPairing: The call app must be paired first.
reasons.needsOsPermission: Needs a permission of the system.
reasons.consentNotGiven: You have not allowed DeckPilot to control calls.

back.title: Back to work
back.description: When a device that went back to work shows the call again. Changing this counts as an edit of the layout, so a new version of it does not replace yours.
back.noKey: This Calls layout has no Back to work key, so there is nothing to set.

modes.completionOrMax: When what you started ends, at the latest after a time (default)

back.allDevicesDescription: Every device that shows the call goes back to work, not only the one pressed.
back.failed: The Back to work settings could not be saved

refusals.previewInCall: a call shows on the device, and a call always comes first
refusals.previewDesktopOnly: only the configuration app can show a page on the device
refusals.noLayout: this device model has no Calls layout
refusals.noBackToWork: this Calls layout has no Back to work key
refusals.previewRefused: the device did not take the page
